newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed Oct power sales fall slightly.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed Oct power sales fall slightly.

text.p: Detroit Edison said its October power sales in southeastern Michigan dropped 1.3 percent from the same period in 1995, to 3.7 billion kilowatt hours (kWh).
Electricity sales for October, 1995 were 3.75 billion kWh, the company said in a statement Tuesday.
Sales increases of 1.9 percent to residential customers and 1.5 percent to industrial customers could not offset a 5.1 percent sales decline to commercial customers, Detroit Edison said.
Year-to-date, the company's sales in southeastern Michigan through October increased 0.8 percent compared with the same period last year.

Total sales for the month, including sales to other utilities, declined five percent to 3.8 billion kWh, while year-to-date total sales were down 1.2 percent compared with the same 10 months of 1995, the company said.
Detroit Edison is a subsidiary of DTE Energy Co.
